incident: Electronics Warehouse Break-in at Okhla Industrial Area Phase-III

statements.statement_text: I arrived at the warehouse at 7:30 AM to unlock the gates for morning shipments. The padlock on Gate 2 had been cut with heavy bolt cutters. When I opened the roll-up shutter, I saw pallets in aisle 4 torn open. Approximately 80 high-end smartphones and 25 laptops are missing from the secure cages. Total inventory loss is estimated around 45 lakhs.

I was on duty at the adjacent plastic factory gate from 11 PM to 7 AM. Around 1:45 AM I noticed a white cargo van with dimmed headlights enter the service lane leading to warehouse Gate 2. It remained there for about 40 minutes and drove out towards Mathura Road around 2:30 AM.

I used to work loading pallets at that warehouse but I was laid off last month. On the night of September 12, I was at my cousin's house in Faridabad celebrating a family anniversary. I did not visit Okhla and have nothing to do with any stolen electronics.

I crossed at the warehouse at 7:30 AM when someone was unlocking the gates for morning shipments. He opened all the padlock with his keys and then he start to shift things in a truck like a order or something.
